question.text: An aircraft needs to fly from location A to a destination B, which lies 500 km away along a line 30° east of north. A constant wind blows directly northward at 20 m/s. The speed of the aircraft relative to the air is 150 m/s.

parts.label: a
parts.asks: Determine the heading direction the pilot must steer the aircraft so as to reach destination B directly.

parts.label: b
parts.asks: Calculate the total duration needed for the aircraft to travel from A to B.

conditions: displacement from A to B = 500 km at 30° east of north
aircraft speed relative to air = 150 m/s
motion of aircraft relative to ground is straight along line AB

solution.approach: The wind's component across AB must be cancelled by an opposite component of the plane's airspeed; this fixes the heading, and the remaining along-path components give the ground speed.

steps.text: The wind blows due north while AB is 30° east of north, so resolve the wind across the path AB.
For the plane to travel exactly along AB, the component of its 150 m/s airspeed across AB must cancel this 10 m/s, which fixes the angle between the heading and AB.
The pilot must head 3.8° to the east of the line AB, so the heading is 30° + 3.8° = 33.8° east of north.
steps.why_this_step: Flying straight along AB with no correction would drift the plane west of B, since north (the wind direction) lies west of AB; aiming further east compensates for this.

steps.text: Find the ground speed by adding the along-AB components of the airspeed and the wind, since their across-AB components have cancelled.
Divide the 500 km distance by the ground speed to get the time, and state both results.
steps.equation: t = 500000 m / 167.0 m/s ≈ 2994 s ≈ 49.9 min; heading is 3.8° east of AB (bearing ≈ N33.8°E), time ≈ 49.9 min

final_answer.value: (a) Head the plane 3.8° east of the line AB, i.e. along bearing N33.8°E, (b) about 2994 s ≈ 49.9 minutes

common_mistakes.text: Adding the wind speed directly to the steering speed, ignoring the 30° angle between the wind and AB, gives a ground speed of 170 m/s and a shorter time of about 2941 s.
Setting sinθ = 20/150 instead of resolving the wind across AB first gives a wrong heading of about 37.7° east of north instead of 33.8°.
